name: Schapen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, green and red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Schapen (a white wavy bend between a lamb and a pot on green and red).
history: Municipal flag of Schapen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Schapen arms — wavy bend, lamb and pot
